title: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
title_zh: ANGLER：面向Web智能体的基于验证器的自适应攻击者基准测试

paragraphs.en: 提出REEF红队基准与自适应攻击框架ANGLER，通过状态验证和演化诱饵显著揭示Web智能体安全漏洞。 Web agents are increasingly deployed to complete tasks autonomously on real websites, where adversarially injected content can induce them to perform unauthorized actions. Existing evaluations primarily use fixed attacks or focus on a single attack type, and evaluate attacks at the text level rather than through real state changes, thus underestimating how vulnerable agents are to diverse attacks. To address the gap, we introduce REEF, a benchmark of red-teaming executable environments with faithful verification for measuring the security vulnerabilities of web agents. REEF covers 9 verifier-grounded websites spanning travel, commerce, productivity, media, and communication, and pairs every authentic benign task with a malicious objective delivered through 5 attack types at both the user and the environment level. REEF's state-based verifiers provide the execution feedback that drives ANGLER, an adaptive near-miss-guided lure evolution framework for red-teaming. Rather than evaluating a fixed attack set, ANGLER uses outcomes from prior rollouts to guide LLM-based attack mutation and candidate selection, prioritizing near-miss seeds during refinement. Across 8 VLM-based web agents, ANGLER achieves an end-to-end attack success rate (ASR) of 20.36%, compared with 15.24% for the non-adaptive setting. Compared with attack-free execution on the same benign tasks, attacks generated by ANGLER reduce benign task success rate (BSR) from 61.9% to 44.4%.
paragraphs.zh: 提出REEF红队基准与自适应攻击框架ANGLER，通过状态验证和演化诱饵显著揭示Web智能体安全漏洞。Web智能体正日益被部署用于在真实网站上自主完成任务，而对抗性注入的内容可能诱导它们执行未经授权的操作。 现有评估主要使用固定攻击或聚焦于单一攻击类型，并且在文本层面而非通过真实状态变化来评估攻击，从而低估了智能体面对多样攻击时的脆弱性。 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了REEF，一个带有可信验证的红队可执行环境基准，用于衡量Web智能体的安全漏洞。 REEF涵盖9个以验证器为基础的网站，涉及旅行、电商、生产力、媒体和通信领域，并为每个真实的良性任务配对一个恶意目标，该目标通过用户层和环境层的5种攻击类型传递。 REEF基于状态的验证器提供执行反馈，驱动ANGLER——一个用于红队测试的自适应、近乎命中引导的诱饵演化框架。 ANGLER不再评估固定的攻击集合，而是利用先前 rollout 的结果来指导基于大语言模型的攻击变异与候选选择，并在细化过程中优先考虑近乎命中的种子。 在8个基于VLM的Web智能体上，ANGLER实现了20.36%的端到端攻击成功率（ASR），而非自适应设置为15.24%。 与在相同良性任务上的无攻击执行相比，ANGLER生成的攻击使良性任务成功率（BSR）从61.9%降至44.4%。
